property_summary: For any actor, any deposit with positive value strictly increases that actor's recorded balance (P: balances[a]+v > balances[a]); the mutant overwrites the balance so a smaller second deposit leaves the balance unchanged or lower, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Changed `balances[msg.sender]+= msg.value;` to `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value;`, so the balance is overwritten instead of incremented.
